content.text: What is the optimal route to visit the following objects from the camera's position? Objects to visit: glass door, red stool, the hanging thing close to the camera, the white pillar?

Choices:  A. glass door -> red stool -> hanging thing -> white pilar. B. white pillar -> hanging thing -> red stool -> glass door. C. red stool -> hanging thing -> white pillar -> glass door. D. white pillar -> glass door -> hanging thing -> red stool. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
